source_registry.title: Chains of large gaps between primes
source_registry.authors: Kevin Ford, James Maynard, Terence Tao
source_registry.printed_locations: printed pp. 9 and 11--14; final coordinate extension, conditional covering output, and independent uniform outer A_s coordinates

source_registry.title: DEP-R09 filtration sensitivity and survivor-floor audit
DEP-R09 outer entropy and convolution second-moment reduction

actual_law.outer_space: A=product_(s in S) Z/sZ with card(A)=Q_S
actual_law.outer_marginal: P(A=a)=1/Q_S for every outer vector a
actual_law.conditional_final_output: N-prime has an arbitrary source-defined conditional law given A=a
actual_law.conditional_shift_support: M(a)={m(a,n): n lies in the conditional essential support of N-prime given A=a}
actual_law.event_subprobability: lambda_a(m)=P(S_sieve and m_omega=m | A=a), with sum_m lambda_a(m)<=1
actual_law.disjointness: M(a) and M(a-prime) are disjoint for distinct outer vectors because m mod s=-a_s fixes a uniquely

exact_reduction.support_restricted_fiber_energy: H_FMT(R)=sum_(a in A) max_(m in M(a)) E(m)
exact_reduction.same_law_raw_moment: rho_S=(1/Q_S) sum_a sum_(m in M(a)) lambda_a(m) E(m)
exact_reduction.relation_to_theory82: The Theory-82 character-energy gate implies the new direct fiber gate, but the converse need not hold.

minimax_scope.sharp_statement: For any finite nonempty fibers and nonnegative E, choosing one maximizer deterministically in every fiber and taking the event always true attains H/|A|.
minimax_scope.what_is_optimal: No smaller universal envelope follows from the uniform outer marginal plus conditional support and row-mass-at-most-one alone.
minimax_scope.not_claimed: The actual published FMT conditional law attains this worst case, or its additional probabilities and dependencies cannot improve the bound.

source_applicability.fmt_outer_coordinates: Printed p. 12 chooses A_s uniformly and independently; the final extension keeps those coordinates.
source_applicability.fmt_conditional_output: Printed p. 11 applies the covering theorem separately on each good outer fiber and may choose an arbitrary fallback on bad fibers.
source_applicability.preliminary_product_law: Formula (6.17) is conditional on A and precedes the final covering output; it is not promoted to global independence of the final N-prime.
source_applicability.fixed_subset_theorems: FMT Theorem 4 and FGKMT Corollary 4 control subsets fixed before the covering output, not the output-dependent complex CRT observable.
source_applicability.consequence: A new conditional-weight, martingale, or prime-specific fiber theorem is still required to beat the support maximum for the actual law.

not_claimed: The actual FMT final law attains the abstract maximizing selector.

next_gate: Bound the support-restricted outer-fiber energy for the actual prime-error observable using final-law conditional weights or prime-specific structure; outer uniformity and support alone cannot improve its universal maximum envelope.
